steps.finding: The user requested a global Nubeqa dashboard tracking net sales growth, forecast variance, and market access coverage.

The closest match found in the search is AST-0015 ('All Pharma Net Sales New'), which covers 60% of the request, uses Power BI, and has an active owner (OWN-022) with healthy refresh on semantic model SM-041.
AST-0015 currently lacks key metrics: forecast_variance and market_access_coverage, and records 0 average monthly users.
Other Nubeqa assets like AST-0239 have certified models and high usage (259 avg monthly users) but lack an owner and miss all three requested metrics.
Governance rules highlighted KPI conflicts (RULE-002) across other estate assets like AST-0006, AST-0008, and AST-0018 regarding net sales growth and market access coverage definitions.

why: No existing dashboard covers all three required Nubeqa metrics under a single governed model. AST-0015 provides a healthy, active baseline model (SM-041) to build upon.
risks: AST-0015 currently has 0 average monthly users and requires addition of forecast variance and market access coverage metrics.
Multiple non-canonical KPI definitions exist across the estate (RULE-002) for net sales growth and market access coverage.
